headline: Saudi Arabia Shifts Oil Supply Strategy Amid Regional Tensions
summary: Saudi Arabia has altered its long-standing core oil supply rules amid U.S. military action against Iran and heightened geopolitical volatility in the Middle East.
why: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest crude oil exporter and the de facto leader of OPEC, making its production policy decisions central to global energy pricing.

impacts.name: Brent Crude Futures
impacts.why: Changes in Saudi supply commitments directly alter global crude balance calculations amid regional instability.

why_moved: The abandonment of traditional supply management mechanisms directly impacts international oil supply expectations and price volatility.
